I'm not convinced this saves much time actually, seems like it's now bottlenecked by the v4/v3 reinstall. Maybe that can be done more efficiently?
@Haroenv We can at least get rid of v3 tests imo. Don't know what's the support policy but maybe even v4 even though I guess it's still widely used.
we could, but maybe should we do that at the same time as dropping the code for v3?
@Haroenv Yeah, we could also run those v3/v4 steps only on release PRs ? We barely do stuff that impacts that, and most of the time we just get false negatives from type checks in tests
yes that makes sense, although those tests are parallel and the linting is currently still the slowest step
next step, but it's more significant, so I didn't do it here, is improving the time of eslint.
